apple.name: Openline: Travel eSIM Plans
apple.subtitle: Data plans for travelers
apple.promotional: Travel data on a separate eSIM. Avoid data-roaming surprises, keep your home SIM for calls, follow a simple setup checklist, add travel dates and get 24/7 live chat help.
apple.description:
Heading abroad? Unexpected data-roaming charges from your home mobile operator can catch you off guard. Openline gives you a separate travel eSIM for mobile data. Keep maps, messages and travel apps within reach.

Choose Unlimited usage or Fixed usage plans, where available. Fixed usage provides a set data allowance. Review the plan’s validity, fair-use and applicable usage terms, and check remaining data in the app where applicable.

Getting started is straightforward. Before you travel, turn off data roaming on your home SIM to help avoid unexpected charges. Install your Openline eSIM using the QR code or manual installation details provided. At your destination, follow the website setup guide: select Openline for mobile data, turn on data roaming for Openline, and turn off automatic cellular data switching where available so your device uses Openline as intended.

On compatible dual-SIM iPhones, your home SIM can stay active for calls and SMS. Note that your home operator's charges may still apply for those services.

Openline works with compatible unlocked eSIM-capable iPhones. Compare the data allowance and duration with your usual operator before choosing.

Questions? Reach our team any time via 24/7 live chat at openline.com/contact.
